name: 63120 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63120 (Saint Louis) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63120 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
